children: Robert Edward Hensley, an officer serving as EVP & Chief Investment Officer, reported selling shares of Globe Life common stock. The two sales on September 22, 2026 executed at per-share prices of $169.5311 and $170.3409 produced a combined sale amount of $1,700,701. Following the reported transactions, Hensley directly owns 12,383 common shares and no longer indirectly owns any common shares. The reporting person noted they will provide full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price upon request and included footnote ranges of sale prices from $168.89 to $170.87.
